node.title: FLOOR CONJECTURE: per-pair spread remainder inside R_post <= 16 n^3 at the official candidates
node.statement: FLOOR RE-POSE (2026-07-07, floor campaign): the 2026-07-06 sharpening already matched the consumer (xr_clean_residual_any_gate consumes exactly 'R_post(u,v;A) <= 16 n^3 per pair, post quotient/tangent strips, dihedral + extension inside'; sufficiency is exact integer arithmetic at all six candidates; ~2^100 slack above n^3 in the 2^122-2^127.9 allowance). Now framed as a standing conjecture with the pre-registered falsifier. Opening evidence: E27 remainder at FM-normalized rates, all classifiers at chance, no fifth mechanism. | For every pair (u,v): the number of aligned aperiodic supports whose agreement sets pairwise share cores < k+t-1 (the post-cascade remainder, a spread family in the face-3 sense) is bounded in the budget-compatible form needed by the consumer: R_spread(u,v; A) <= 16 n^3 after the quotient, tangent, dihedral, and extension columns are stripped or counted inside R_post. The old generic poly(n) wording is insufficient for xr_clean_residual_any_gate; the live obligation is the explicit 16 n^3-compatible count. E27's toy data places this remainder in the FM band (unstructured multiplicity >=2 events at FM-normalized rates, all classification tests at chance). This is face 4's residual content after the cascade lemma: a spread-family count whose natural instruments are face-3 design bounds, syzygy circuits, and the exception classes. | SURVIVAL +1 scoped (2026-07-07, F5-A1): rungs-2a/2b certificate gate PASS (38 checks); exact greedy spread families = exactly q (slope-limited) at all 5 completed rungs vs 16n^3 budgets — four orders of magnitude of margin, zero alarms with adversarial pencil pairs; q=71 rung to A1b. | SURVIVAL +2 (2026-07-07, F5-A2): adversarial spread engineering saturates at Theta(n) (0.55n measured across 3 scales; dimension count — sigma conditions per alignment against 2n dof — confirmed), 4-6 orders under budget; the dimension argument is a proof lead for the floor. | SURVIVAL +3 -> **HARDENED** (2026-07-07, F5-A3): strip-integrity depth spectra — random-word tangent cores collapse by d=2 at every scale; adversarial cascades classify as the ledger's charged binomial dressings. Families: slope-limited spread / engineered dimension-cap / strip-integrity. | SURVIVAL +4 (2026-07-07, Pro floor-window 5): genuine Pro attack on the shared-syzygy surface incl. k >= 4 — dependencies collapse into Pi_S(v)=0 invalid columns (live supports <= 3); no kill. Proof lead banked: the live-syzygy lemma. | PROGRAM SATELLITES (2026-07-07): the F5 proof program's banked theorems are now first-class nodes — f5_toy_window_theorem, f5_sunflower_pencil_lemma, f5_near_pencil_reduction (all PROVED, ev), f5_npb_conditional_close (CONDITIONAL on shared_census_kernel, ev). This red remains the single leaf; its genuinely open content = the far-from-pencil anti-concentration heart + the W-multiplicity aggregation + the low-core instrument (F5_SKELETON.md P5-P7 ledger). || P8 ADDENDUM (2026-07-08, upstream import replayed): the W-multiplicity aggregation is INSTRUMENTED — per-W pencil budgets aggregate by rays with exact fiber C(s,k) (f5_lineray_saturation_instrument); stratum (i)'s residual open is the W-collision moment (#k-cores carrying >= 2 live slopes). || P9 ADDENDUM (2026-07-09): the W-collision moment is INSTRUMENTED — pair-moment identity T1-T4 (f5_wcollision_pair_moment_identity, PROVED, replayed exact on 14 pairs): W-collisions aggregate by codeword-pair fibers with exact factor C(L,2)*C(J,k); at the t=2 boundary the collision moment IS the second moment of pencil live counts (mult(W) = L(P_W,Q_W)), SP-shaped and adjacent to the PROVED v13_second_moment_shift_pair_identity. Stratum (i)'s residual open is now the pencil-live-count second-moment bound. SLACK SCAN (same day): RETARGET-DEAD — prize rows tight at 29n^3 vs 16n^3 (0.86 bits); the heart must deliver the n^3 form as stated. || AMBER SURGERY (2026-07-10, fresh-context audit AMBER-READY on the two-predicate stratum route; the K2-reduction route stays refused per WP2 — different question, both answers stand): CONDITIONAL — machine-verified assembly: IF xr_highcore_collision_count supplies P-A1 <= 8n^3 on generic pairs and P-A2 <= 16n^3 combined on nongeneric pairs, AND xr_lowcore_spread_heart supplies P-B <= 8n^3 on generic pairs, THEN R_post(u,v;A) <= 16n^3 for every received pair at all six candidates — the generic composition 8+8=16 and nongeneric P-A2 combined 16 are exact with zero hidden constants (M6, the WP2-named blocker, DONE: no proved stratum consumes budget inside R_post at the candidates). Every non-predicate link PROVED or pinned: support-wise mismatch case split (proved by xr_tangent_support_mismatch_bridge; nongeneric mass routes to P-A2 without a per-stratum split); strips + rungs + consumption (xr_strip_classification_rungs, three independent implementations); automatic validity; exhaustive high/low-core dichotomy (definitional pin: dihedral + extension inside — M7 dissolved). PINS: P1 slope-count form (same-slope population is the LIST lane's debt — M1 not consumed); P2 post-strip = the gate's ledgers, B_tan worst-case n-A+1; P3 dihedral/extension inside (E30 odd-j anti-reciprocal caveat); P4 row pins + I2 q-pin caveat; P5 per-pair sup form; P6 FM-witnessing caveat. DRIFT CORRECTIONS (catch #43): statement.md was stale (old CONDITIONAL header + generic poly(n) wording — a Cn^5 proof would have satisfied it and broken the consumer); the 'WIRING FIX: u1_pullback_dichotomy ev->req' line is RETRACTED (the promotion died in the 07-05 retraction; edge is ev); '~2^100 slack above n^3' corrected to 2^92.000 (RowC) / 2^4.9 (prize). RE-SURGERY (demote to TARGET) if: either predicate falsified as stated; candidate pins change (deciding scales, B*, I2 ruling, #493/QA.22 re-attribution) — re-run the banked composition script; a post-strip live cross pair with core in [k+1, A-2] surviving the tangent ledger at any scaled row; B_tan resolved above n-A+1 or B_quot convention change; or the maintainer rejects the two-predicate grain (governance call, precedent worst_word/petal). | [ROUTE-T ADDENDUM 2026-08-02 (ratified): 'post-cascade remainder ... cores < k+t-1' above is corrected — nothing banked removes or charges the band [k+1, A-2], and the cascade tier's charge was unsourced. Route of record: the R2 three-way partition — band column [k+1, A-1] <= 4n^3 (xr_graded_tangent_band_charge, cascade tier d = h-1 named, from the 13n^3 headroom; 20n^3 <= 29n^3 at every row) + P-A1 exact-k + P-B <= k-1; R_spread's 16n^3 obligation covers the post-band-column remainder (cores <= k). Re-surgery criterion 3 re-scoped accordingly (band pairs are expected column members; the trigger is column overflow or a post-column core >= k+1).]
